{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Diamond equipment''' is the highest base tier. It has no intrinsics of its own, but it is the only base that can take [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] or [[Adamant equipment|adamant]].

== Obtaining ==
Diamond ore drops [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]], which must be smelted in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/diamond_from_blasting_diamond_materials.json}}</ref> The 1.12.2 notes explain that this stops free diamonds from surface structures and makes players "feel good to finally be able to USE the diamonds you collected".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=This should extend the copper and iron age a bit more, and when you finally have a blast furnace, feel good to finally be able to USE the diamonds you collected}}</ref>

== Mining ==
The diamond pickaxe and dolabra mine obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 35.

== Differences from vanilla ==
Diamond tools have 2500 durability and diamond armor 800 for every piece.
